## Context / immutable basis
This reconciler-test cohort contains 50 confirmed bloated prose blocks across exactly 11 file-impact paths. Condense repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, and obsolete history while retaining current non-obvious contracts.

The inventory and before-citations are pinned to `origin/main@d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1`. A path-scoped comparison through `9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45` found identical blobs. Implement from current `origin/main`; keep d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1 as the immutable before side. This leaf is one commit, so path checks use `HEAD^..HEAD`.

## Editing boundary and semantic guard
Edit only allowlisted comments/docstrings plus adjacent blank lines. Executable statements, assertions, runtime strings, directives, and unlisted prose stay unchanged. Rewrite stale RED/pre-fix language as current contracts.

For every path, parse immutable and final source with `ast.parse(source, type_comments=True)`; recursively strip only a leading `Expr(Constant(str))` from each `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, and `AsyncFunctionDef`; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require exact `ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False)` equality. A tokenizer guard separately preserves directive text/attachment; runtime strings remain AST-identical.

## Scope — 50 editable blocks
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conflict/test_conflict_bug_filing_4527.py` (1) — module docstring beginning “Hardened conflict bug filing…”. Preserve dedup-before-create, accumulated identifiers, safe argv execution, and fallback filing.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conflict/test_conflict_filing_deferred.py` (5) — module docstring; docstrings of test_inbound_conflict_leaf_does_not_invoke_subprocess, test_apply_files_pending_bug_tickets_after_apply_batch_returns, and test_apply_files_pending_bug_tickets_when_apply_batch_raises; comment beginning “Structural assertion: the leaf must NOT…”. Preserve implemented deferred filing after the apply loop, pending directive data, finally-path filing, exception re-raise, and follow-on suppression.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conflict/test_conflict_resolver_cap.py` (2) — module and test_cap_truncates_over_capacity_input docstrings. Preserve 50-element FIFO behavior for at/below/over-capacity provenance without overexplaining assertions.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conflict/test_conflict_resolver_no_rebar_id_writes.py` (20) — module plus four docstrings (`_assert_no_rebar_id_label_writes` and the matrix/resolver/applier-guard tests); 15 comments starting “Each case”, “The 6 cases”, cases `(a)`–`(f)` including `(e2)/(e3)`, “The xfail cases”, “The test below”, “Current behavior”, “2. Build”, and “3. Invoke”. Preserve the draft-9 distinctions, differ suppression, resolver union, authorized-writer boundary, and applier guard as current contracts.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conflict/test_conflict_resolver.py` (1) — module docstring beginning “Unit tests for rebar_reconciler/conflict_resolver.py”. Preserve the concise one-line per-test contracts remain unedited; only the redundant module inventory is condensed.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conflict/test_parent_sync.py` (1) — module docstring beginning “RED tests for bidirectional parent/child…”. Preserve the implemented outbound, inbound, applier, and fetch-enrichment parent-sync contracts; all concise per-test docstrings and navigation remain unedited.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conflict/test_preflight_status_dict.py` (4) — module docstring; docstrings of test_preflight_skips_inbound_mutations, test_preflight_accepts_outbound_jira_side_status_name, and test_preflight_warns_on_truly_unmapped_status. Preserve implemented dict normalization, direction-aware checking, local-to-Jira values, and nonfatal warnings.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conflict/test_read_latest_status_reducer.py` (2) — module docstring and comment beginning “Two STATUS events branching from the SAME parent…”. Preserve reducer agreement after compaction and deterministic fork resolution rather than raw file order.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conflict/test_status_annotation_labels.py` (9) — module; seven multiline test docstrings (blocked/cancelled mapping, blocked-label removal, inbound blocked, In Review, and both tag-sync exclusions); comment starting “The rebar-status:blocked label removal…”. Preserve bidirectional annotation mapping, transition targets, single removal, and tag exclusion. The old plan’s nine short `C` headings are explicitly excluded.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conflict/test_status_preflight.py` (3) — module plus test_missing_status_warns_but_does_not_abort and test_unmapped_jira_status_not_mislabeled_as_local docstrings. Preserve nonfatal but visible unmapped-status handling, correct Jira-side terminology, mapped control, kill switch, and action filtering.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conflict/test_status_transition_rest.py` (2) — module and test_transition_matches_via_to_state_name docstrings. Preserve implemented REST transition lookup/post, case-insensitive and destination-state matching, and actionable unreachable-state errors.

## Consumers and protected directives
Pytest directly collects every impacted module; `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py` is the deterministic prose-policy consumer. No targeted `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, or doctest consumer was found. Thirteen protected `# type: ignore[union-attr]` tokens: one in each of seven named non-parent-sync files and six in `test_parent_sync.py`. Preserve each complete directive token and its attached executable statement exactly.

## Independent review receipt
A reviewer who did not author the prose change must post exactly 50 leaf-linked TSV rows, one per edited block:
`path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session`

Both verdicts are `PASS`, citations use full SHAs, and every after count is lower. Missing, duplicate, or extra rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The TSV has exactly 50 unique rows mapping one-to-one to the 50 allowlisted blocks.
- [ ] Every TSV row has full before/final SHA citations.
- [ ] Every TSV row has `after_words < before_words`.
- [ ] Every TSV row has `bloat-removal=PASS`.
- [ ] Every TSV row has `semantic-preservation=PASS`.
- [ ] Every TSV row has `directives_exact=PASS`.
- [ ] Every `reviewer-session` names a reviewer who did not author the remediation.
- [ ] DD `semantic` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `directives` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `paths` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `diff` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `hygiene` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `focused` exits 0.
- [ ] DD `full` exits 0 without a timeout.

## Verification
Run all seven structured commands: `semantic`, `directives`, `paths`, `diff`, `hygiene`, `focused`, and `full`. Executable guards prove behavior/directive/path preservation; the TSV decides each block’s semantic preservation and bloat removal.
